email_subject: Your weekend trail just got a 600 ml companion
email_body:
Hi walker,

Saturday's trail is calling, and the LumaTrail Everyday Bottle is ready to come along. It holds 600 ml and keeps drinks cold for up to 12 hours under laboratory test conditions. Pop it in your bag knowing it's leak-resistant when the lid is correctly closed. Yours for €24. Totally leak-free in any bag.

Grab your boots, fill up and go!
